title: DesktopRequestPayloadV1
description: The closed set of request payloads the five Phase-01 desktop operations accept. Every payload is a closed object; there is no Record<string, unknown> escape hatch and no arbitrary JSON anywhere in the set.
$comment: الاتحاد هنا يعطي المجموعة اسمًا وملفًا واحدًا. سلطة الربط بين العملية وحمولتها ليست هنا بل في IPCEnvelopeV1: هناك يُقيَّد كل operation بحمولته بالضبط، وهنا تُعرَّف الأشكال وتُولَّد أنواعها.

DesktopBootstrapRequestV1.title: DesktopBootstrapRequestV1
DesktopBootstrapRequestV1.description: Bootstrap takes no parameters. It is an empty closed object rather than an absent payload: the envelope already requires `payload`, and a closed empty object states that nothing may be smuggled in beside it. The contract version travels on the envelope, so the payload does not restate it.

DesktopRuntimeStatusRequestV1.title: DesktopRuntimeStatusRequestV1
DesktopRuntimeStatusRequestV1.description: Runtime status takes no parameters, for the same reason as bootstrap.

capability_ids.description: A bounded, explicit query. There is deliberately no 'all capabilities' wildcard: an unbounded query is a small dispatcher.

section_ids.description: Restricts the description to the named sections. Absent means the whole tree, which is bounded by the host's own section catalogue and not by the caller.

DesktopSettingsReadRequestV1.title: DesktopSettingsReadRequestV1

setting_ids.description: Restricts the read to named settings inside the section. Absent means the whole section.

DesktopSettingsReadRequestV1.description: Reads one named section. A read spanning sections is not expressible, so a single request can never become a settings dump.
